Date: 08/01/2016 ## To All the Non Life/Health Insurers, # **Re: Filing of Micro Insurance Products subsequent to the implementation of IRDAI (Micro Insurance) Regulations, 2015** Authority. Reference is also invited to Schedule I of MIR, 2015 that specified the 1. Reference is invited to Regulation (8) (1) of IRDAI (Micro Insurance) Regulations, 2015 (MIR, 2015} which specifies that every insurer is subject to File and Use Procedure with respect to filing of Micro Insurance Products with the terms in respect of General Micro Insurance Products defined at Regulation (2) (d) of MIR, 2015. 2. chunks.heading: **Re: Filing of Micro Insurance Products subsequent to the implementation of IRDAI (Micro Insurance) Regulations, 2015**
chunks.content:
Authority. Reference is also invited to Schedule I of MIR, 2015 that specified the 1. Reference is invited to Regulation (8) (1) of IRDAI (Micro Insurance) Regulations, 2015 (MIR, 2015} which specifies that every insurer is subject to File and Use Procedure with respect to filing of Micro Insurance Products with the terms in respect of General Micro Insurance Products defined at Regulation (2) (d) of MIR, 2015. 

2. In accordance with the prov1s1ons of Regulation (18} of MIR, 2015 it is clarified that Insurers are now permitted to adopt the existing General Micro Insurance Products so as to meet the terms specified in Schedule - I of MIR, 2015 by complying with the following conditions. 

- (i) Insurers at their discretion may modify the existing General Micro Insurance Product features other than those relating to any benefits offered, premium bases, loading levied or discounts offered in the products. It is further clarified that any change in the Sum Assured or any other terms specified in Schedule - I of MIR, 2015 shall not impact the price of the product. 

- Where such modifications suffice to render the General Micro Insurance effect filed by the Appointed Actuary and the CEO in the format prescribed I, the Insurers may be permitted to continue to offer the 

- (ii) Product compliant to MIR, 2015, then on the basis of a certificate to that at Annexure - existing General Micro insurance Product with modified terms.
